carrier_entities.env_volumetric_fog_controller: the one global volumetric fog controller: density, height_fog_density, height_fog_falloff, anisotropy
carrier_entities.env_volumetric_fog_volume: a homogeneous box medium: origin, box_mins and box_maxs (relative), density (extinction per Source unit), albedo (scattering / extinction), anisotropy (Henyey-Greenstein g), emission
carrier_entities.light_rect: a rectangle light: origin (centre), angles (forward = the emission direction, the rectangle's normal), width along -right and height along up (halfU = -right x width/2, halfV = up x height/2) in Source units, color (linear 0..255) and brightness (radiance = color / 255 x brightness, lightmap unit), two_sided; render.area-light.v1's Rect and AreaLight
carrier_entities.status: decided by the render-core owner (source-engine-43, 2026-09-29, binding rule 5) with Source 2's names; the game entities are RFC 0016 K12's

error_metric.definition: e(p) = max over R, G, B of |lab(p) - ref(p)| / Y_ref, with Y_ref the mean Rec. 709 luminance of the reference over the judged pixels; mean is the average of e over the judged pixels and p99 its 99th percentile
error_metric.judged_pixels: pixels whose reference object index is a scene mesh (not the background or sky, index 0) and not a light's own visible emitter shape (LightQuad*/LightDisk* meshes: the lab draws no light shapes)
error_metric.space: linear scene radiance in the pipeline's lightmap unit, before exposure, tone map and output encoding; the lab image is a linear PFM of the same film and pose

fixtures.name: cornell-floors
fixtures.purpose: The Cornell box with its floor split into a rough half (roughness 0.5) and a polished half (0.05): the ceiling rectangle's direct light and soft shadows, the colored bleed, and on the polished half the reflections of the walls and blocks (image-based and screen-space specular)

fixtures.name: area-room
fixtures.purpose: An 8 x 6 m room lit by 64 rectangular lights: 48 colored ceiling panels and 16 low wall strips whose light grazes the floor (horizon clipping), over floor stripes of roughness 0.1, 0.3 and 0.6 that stretch each panel's highlight, with pedestals casting soft shadows and an emissive sign that is not a light

fixtures.name: projector-cookie
fixtures.purpose: A dark room where an env_projectedtexture shines a window cookie onto a Lambertian floor and back wall past a pillar that shadows it and a glossy sphere that reflects it, under a dim fill rectangle; Portal's attenuation (linear 100 / d, clamped) and end falloff past 0.6 far

fixtures.name: sun-colonnade
fixtures.purpose: A 30 m portico: ten columns under a roof slab, a back wall and a sunlit yard, lit by a low warm sun (35 degrees) and a blue sky, seen along the colonnade so column shadows run from near to far (cascades) and from the yard

fixtures.name: foggy-hall
fixtures.purpose: A 24 m hall filled with a homogeneous medium (scattering 0.06/m, absorption 0.01/m, anisotropy 0.3): 16 ceiling spots draw shafts, 240 colored bulbs line the walls (256 clustered lights), and a projector at the far end throws a shaft that a pillar shadows; the clear state is the same hall with density zero

fixtures.name: mirror-corridor
fixtures.purpose: An 18 m corridor whose floor runs from a mirror (metal, roughness 0.02) through gloss 0.1 and 0.25 to 0.5 (above the SSR cutoff), between colored wall panels, under ceiling strips, with a block near the camera whose reflection leaves the screen (probe fallback)

fixtures.name: material-sweep
fixtures.purpose: Three rows of eight smooth spheres at roughness 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0: gold metal, a clear coat (coat roughness swept) over a red base, and a white dielectric, in a studio with colored walls under a key rectangle and a spot

fixtures.name: portal-pair
fixtures.purpose: Light through a linked portal pair on perpendicular walls: room A's ceiling rectangle and a spot aimed through portal A past a post light room B, which has only a dim lamp of its own, through the pair's elliptical opening; B's polished floor reflects what comes through, its probe sphere and block take the light, and from A the view through portal A shows B lit by A. Judged open (the rooms joined through the opening) and closed (sealed)

fixtures.name: portal-chamber
fixtures.purpose: Portal's testchmb_a_00 relit by the one lighting back end: its world faces, VMT materials and vrad world lights as a derived USD scene

fixtures.name: portal2-chamber
fixtures.purpose: The clean-Aperture Portal 2 test chamber sp_gi_chamber_01 built by portal2_gi_chamber.py: triple-laser tiles ($ssbump as normal and AO), light_spot panels and switchable light_dynamic accents

reference_policy.light_paths: gi-reference (64 diffuse, 16 glossy bounces, no clamping, no volume bounces: single scattering)
reference_policy.preview_is_diagnostic: a comparison against a preview reference is recorded but certifies nothing
reference_policy.renderer: tools/quality/lighting_reference_blender.py over gi_reference_blender.py (usd_scene.py extract, pbrt_blender material and emitter policy)

ambient-occlusion.negative_control: GTAO over the baked indirect light with no rule (double occlusion), or applied to direct light: contact regions darken past tolerance

area-lights.negative_control: each rectangle evaluated as a point at its centre (no LTC) and without horizon clipping: the glossy floor stripes' elongated highlights and the wall strips' grazing light fail

brdf.negative_control: the lobe seeded wrong: energy compensation off (as cl_render_debug_brdf 3), or a Lambert lobe in place of GGX: the rough metal spheres and the polished floor leave tolerance

direct-visibility.negative_control: visibility one (shadows off): the pillar, block and column shadows vanish and p99 fails

emission.negative_control: emission zero: the area room's sign and the light it casts are missing

filtered-roughness.negative_control: input roughness in place of the filtered roughness: the distant mirror and polished floor texels sparkle above the p99 tolerance

image-based-specular.negative_control: reflectance zero, or the wrong prefiltered mip: glossy spheres and floors lose their reflections

indirect-diffuse-dynamic.negative_control: the probe volume replaced by a black ambient cube: the dynamic ProbeSphere's region leaves tolerance

indirect-diffuse-static.negative_control: the lightmap's indirect layer zero (or the total layer used with runtime direct light, doubling it): every closed room fails its mean

output.negative_control: not judged by these fixtures: every comparison is of linear scene radiance before exposure and output; render.output owns the term

participating-media.negative_control: density zero (the clear state's frame) judged against the fog reference, and the projector's shaft drawn inside its shadow

portal-transport.negative_control: the pair closed (no images, no view through it) judged against the open reference: room B's floor, walls and the view through the portal fail; the opening's rectangle in place of its ellipse (render.portal-lights.v1 P2's clip) shows as extra light at the corners of each through-portal pool
portal-transport.owner: unittests/rendertest/contracts/render.portal-lights.v1.md (RFC 0011; each term evaluated through open portal pairs by its images; decided by the render-core owner, source-engine-43, 2026-09-29)

projected-lights.negative_control: the cookie ignored (white) or its v axis flipped: the window pattern on the back wall leaves tolerance

runtime-lights.negative_control: every other clustered light dropped from its cluster lists (a seeded assignment defect): the hall's wall pools go dark

screen-space-reflections.negative_control: thickness ignored, no edge fade or the wrong mip (the K11 seeded defects), and SSR off: the mirror corridor's on-screen hits fail

specular-occlusion.negative_control: specular occlusion one: probe reflections leak into the creases under the blocks and pillars

sun.negative_control: the cascades' splits swapped, or the sun removed: the colonnade's far shadows and sunlit floor leave tolerance

units.light: the pipeline's lightmap unit: a white Lambertian surface under irradiance E shows E / pi (Cycles diffuse passes)
units.stage: meters, Z up (metersPerUnit 1) for the synthetic fixtures
